g.text: Current budget graph: one run for one user and date
First fit: up to 3 prior calendar months.
Fixed: lower median of paying months.
Flexible: median x 1.05; skip zero median.
Persist fit evidence with budget lines.
Sync failures keep checking stored data.
Code builds facts and proposed limits
Gateway minimizes and audits each category
then falls back to an ordinary alert.
Transport failure marks the run error.
Memory asks model to avoid repeats.
Only recurring causes may adjust a limit.
